glosses: X-ray (short wavelength electromagnetic radiation or photograph made with X-rays)
röntgen (roentgen) (a unit of exposure to ionizing radiation)

examples.text: Завтра я должен идти на рентген.
examples.en: I have to go and have an X-ray tomorrow.

examples.text: Давайте сделаем рентген на всякий случай.
examples.en: Let's take an X-ray just in case.
The fracture needs to be X-rayed.

examples.text: Рентген показал, что сломано два пальца.
examples.en: The X-ray showed two broken fingers.
